verdict.rationale: Saving and sharing filtered views is a fair question for a work-management product like Asana, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents saving a filtered view or sharing it by link. The only nearby items are MCP natural-language searches (e.g. 'Find all my incomplete tasks due this week'), which are one-off queries rather than saved, link-shareable views and are not credited.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can save a filtered view of work and share it with a link
